title: Venom library design and deep-learning homology mining find itch receptor MRGPRX4 ligands
summary: A computationally designed library of animal venoms and metavenoms, displayed on M13 hyperphage and screened by single-round biopanning with high-throughput sequencing, yielded Kunitz-type domain proteins targeting the itch receptor MRGPRX4. Deep-learning structural homology mining identified two human homologs, TFPI and SPINT2, which showed agonist-dependent potentiation of MRGPRX4. Preprint; the deep-learning step is one part of a mainly experimental platform.
ai_technology: Computational library design and deep-learning structural homology mining
